María Gomez: Hi finance team — quick question from Buenos Aires trip. I paid a porter in cash (ARS 2,500) at Hotel Alvear and they only gave me a handwritten note with the amount and date. No formal receipt. Can I still claim this?
Alex K.: Hi María — short answer: yes, under incidental travel tips we can reimburse cash tips if manager approves and you provide backup. Please attach the photo of the note and any hotel folio you have.
María Gomez: Uploaded photos here: https://img.redwood-internal/receipts/boa_note.jpg and https://img.redwood-internal/receipts/boa_folio.jpg. The folio shows the stay but not the porter line item.
Alex K.: Good. Two procedural items: 1) manager sign-off on the expense form, 2) currency conversion note (we reimburse in employee home currency by default). Do you want USD?
María Gomez: Yes please USD. Also what FX should I use?
Finance-Bot: Per policy use the daily mid-market rate on the date of purchase. Acceptable sources: XE, OANDA, Google. Include a screenshot or link to the rate. Example: "Expense currency: ARS, Converted currency: USD, FX source: XE, Rate date: 2026-03-18"
Liz M. (Manager): I approve reimbursement up to USD 20 for porter tip. Adding approval note here. :thumbsup:
Alex K.: Noted manager approval. When you submit select: Expense type = "Incidental - Travel (Tip)", Amount = "ARS 2,500", attach both images, and add comment "Liz M. approved". Reference FIN-EXP-TRV-003 in the policy field.
María Gomez: Submitted expense ID 987654, attached photos and XE screenshot for 2026-03-18 conversion.
Finance-Bot: Expense 987654 received. Status: Pending Manager Approval.
Alex K.: I'll review the docs and process in the next expense run. FYI our threshold for handwritten backup for tips is USD 50; beyond that we require an official fiscal receipt in many countries.
Jordan C. (Legal): Small legal note: for Argentina tax purposes, reimbursements above ~USD 100 often need a fiscal receipt if company wants to claim VAT. This one is below threshold so fine; keep the images for audit.
María Gomez: Thanks everyone. Is payout on next Tuesday's run?
Alex K.: Yes, next Tuesday. If you need urgent payment we can escalate to AP.
María Gomez: All good. Closing thread. :)
